issue.title: log_ssd_health timeouts when executing from shell and during warm-reboot

failure.body:
#### Description

Issue introduced after https://github.com/Azure/sonic-utilities/pull/1850
timeout command was added to smartctl. However, the smartctl command in host is a wrapper which calls docker exec -it  pmon smartctl. With the interactive mode, the command doesn't return and it times out.  This is documented in the bug https://github.com/moby/moby/issues/28207#issuecomment-260322321 and recommendation is to use --foreground in timeout command which solves the issue

In the below logs between successive commands the log_sdd_health takes 30 seconds and timeouts
Oct 20 <IPV6>.134719 arc-switch1025 NOTICE admin: Collecting logs to check ssd health before fast-reboot...
Oct 20 <IPV6>.154005 arc-switch1025 NOTICE admin: Stopping nat ...

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run log_ssd_health in bash. It will not return until timeout (30 sec)
2.
3.

#### Describe the results you received:
The command hangs

#### Describe the results you expected:
The command shouldn't hang

resolution.title: [log_ssd_health]Fix log_ssd_health hang issue
resolution.description:
#### What I did
Fix https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/9114
The log_ssd_health command hangs due to timeout being used with docker exec -i which also affect warmboot flow.

#### How I did it
Added foreground option for timeout. This is recommended when not using the command on shell
https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/timeout.1.html

#### How to verify it
Run log_ssd_health and verify it does not hang

Signed-off-by: Sudharsan Dhamal Gopalarathnam <<EMAIL>>
